equity_bank_db=# -- Query 1: Display customers with total loan amount > 1,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_type,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.district_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_loan_repayment_amount
equity_bank_db-# FROM CUSTOMER c
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON c.customer_id = ba.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON ba.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, at.account_type_name, 
equity_bank_db-#          bb.branch_name, bb.district_name
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) > 1000000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 2: Display customers with number of deposits less than 3 (including those with no deposits)
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     c.registration_date,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     ba.opening_date AS account_opening_date,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(d.deposit_id) AS number_of_deposits,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount
equity_bank_db-# FROM CUSTOMER c
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON c.customer_id = ba.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON ba.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, c.registration_date, at.account_type_name, 
equity_bank_db-#          ba.opening_date, bb.branch_name
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COUNT(d.deposit_id) < 3
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY number_of_deposits DESC, c.customer_name;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 3: Display all account types with total deposited amount < 5,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_id,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     at.minimum_balance,
equity_bank_db-#     at.interest_rate,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS number_of_customer_accounts,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount
equity_bank_db-# FROM BANK_ACCOUNT ba
equity_bank_db-# RIGHT JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY at.account_type_id, at.account_type_name, at.minimum_balance, at.interest_rate
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) < 5000000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY total_deposited_amount DESC;
 account_type_id | account_type_name | minimum_balance | interest_rate | number_of_customer_accounts | total_deposited_amount | total_withdrawn_amount

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 5: Display accounts where total withdrawals > total deposits
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     ba.opening_date AS account_opening_date,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(d.deposit_id) AS number_of_deposits,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount
equity_bank_db-# FROM BANK_ACCOUNT ba
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER c ON ba.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, ba.opening_date, at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#          ba.account_id
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0)
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0)) DESC;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 6: Display all cards linked to accounts with total deposits > 1,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bc.card_number,
equity_bank_db-#     bc.card_type,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(d.deposit_id) AS number_of_deposits,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount
equity_bank_db-# FROM BANK_CARD bc
equity_bank_db-# RIGHT JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON bc.account_id = ba.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER c ON ba.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, bc.card_number, bc.card_type, at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#          ba.account_id
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) > 1000000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY total_deposited_amount DESC;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 7: Display loans with outstanding balance > 0
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     lt.loan_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     l.loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     lt.interest_rate,
equity_bank_db-#     lt.maximum_period_months,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(lr.repayment_id) AS number_of_repayments,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     (l.loan_amount - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) AS outstanding_loan_balance
equity_bank_db-# FROM LOAN l
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN CUSTOMER c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN LOAN_TYPE lt ON l.loan_type_id = lt.loan_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, lt.loan_type_name, l.loan_amount, 
equity_bank_db-#          lt.interest_rate, lt.maximum_period_months, l.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# HAVING (l.loan_amount - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) > 0
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY outstanding_loan_balance DESC;
 national_id |       customer_name       |    loan_type_name     | loan_amount | interest_rate | maximum_period_months | number_of_repayments | total_repayment_amount | outstanding_loan_balance

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 8: Display loans with total collateral value > 2,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     lt.loan_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     e.employee_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT g.guarantor_id) AS number_of_guarantors,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS number_of_collateral_records,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(cl.collateral_value), 0) AS total_collateral_value
equity_bank_db-# FROM LOAN l
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_TYPE lt ON l.loan_type_id = lt.loan_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_EMPLOYEE e ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON e.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN GUARANTOR g ON l.loan_id = g.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN COLLATERAL cl ON l.loan_id = cl.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, lt.loan_type_name, e.employee_name, 
equity_bank_db-#          bb.branch_name, l.loan_id

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 9: Display all employees with average loan amount > 500,000

equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.employee_position, bb.branch_name, bb.district_name

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 10: Display loans with at least one guarantor and guaranteed amount > 100,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     l.loan_id,
equity_bank_db-#     lt.loan_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     l.loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(cl.collateral_value), 0) AS total_collateral_value
equity_bank_db-# FROM LOAN l
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN CUSTOMER c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN LOAN_TYPE lt ON l.loan_type_id = lt.loan_type_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN GUARANTOR g ON l.loan_id = g.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN COLLATERAL cl ON l.loan_id = cl.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, l.loan_id, lt.loan_type_name, l.loan_amount
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COUNT(g.guarantor_id) >= 1 AND COALESCE(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 0) > 100000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;
 national_id | customer_name | loan_id | loan_type_name | loan_amount | total_repayment_amount | total_guaranteed_amount | total_collateral_value

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 11: Display loans with outstanding balance > 500,000 (including those without repayments)
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     l.loan_id,
equity_bank_db-#     l.loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(lr.repayment_id) AS number_of_repayments,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     (l.loan_amount - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) AS outstanding_balance
equity_bank_db-# FROM LOAN l
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, l.loan_id, l.loan_amount
equity_bank_db-# HAVING (l.loan_amount - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) > 500000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY outstanding_balance DESC;
 national_id |       customer_name       | loan_id | loan_amount | number_of_repayments | total_repayment_amount | outstanding_balance

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 12: Display all branches with total deposited amount < 20,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_id,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.district_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_manager,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS number_of_customer_accounts,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(AVG(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS average_deposit_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(MAX(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS maximum_deposit_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(MIN(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS minimum_deposit_amount
equity_bank_db-# FROM BANK_BRANCH bb
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON bb.branch_id = ba.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY bb.branch_id, bb.branch_name, bb.district_name, bb.branch_manager
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) < 20000000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY total_deposited_amount DESC;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 13: Display customers with net account movement > 1,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     cu.currency_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(d.deposit_id) AS number_of_deposits,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     (COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0)) AS net_account_movement
equity_bank_db-# FROM CUSTOMER c
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON c.customer_id = ba.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON ba.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN CURRENCY cu ON d.currency_id = cu.currency_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, at.account_type_name, bb.branch_name, cu.currency_name
equity_bank_db-# HAVING (COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0)) > 1000000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY net_account_movement DESC;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 14: Display accounts with withdrawal percentage > 10%
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     ba.account_id,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     CASE 
equity_bank_db-#         WHEN COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) > 0 
equity_bank_db-#         THEN (COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) / COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0)) * 100
equity_bank_db-#         ELSE 0
equity_bank_db-#     END AS withdrawal_percentage
equity_bank_db-# FROM BANK_ACCOUNT ba
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER c ON ba.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, ba.account_id
equity_bank_db-# HAVING 
equity_bank_db-#     CASE 
equity_bank_db-#         WHEN COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) > 0 
equity_bank_db-#         THEN (COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) / COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0)) * 100
equity_bank_db-#         ELSE 0
equity_bank_db-#     END > 10
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY withdrawal_percentage DESC;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 15: Display branch targets where total deposited amount is below target
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_id,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.district_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_manager,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bt.target_year,
equity_bank_db-#     bt.target_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     (COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0)) AS net_deposits
equity_bank_db-# FROM BRANCH_TARGET bt
equity_bank_db-# RIGHT JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON bt.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON bt.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON bb.branch_id = ba.branch_id AND ba.account_type_id = bt.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY bb.branch_id, bb.branch_name, bb.district_name, bb.branch_manager, 
equity_bank_db-#          at.account_type_name, bt.target_year, bt.target_amount
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) < bt.target_amount
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY (bt.target_amount - COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0)) DESC;

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 16: Display employees with >5 withdrawals and total loans > 1,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     e.employee_id,
equity_bank_db-#     e.employee_name,
equity_bank_db-#     e.employee_position,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT w.withdrawal_id) AS number_of_withdrawals_processed,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS number_of_loans_processed,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT cc.complaint_id) AS number_of_complaints_handled,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cc.complaint_status != 'Closed' AND cc.complaint_status != 'Resolved' THEN cc.complaint_id END) AS number_of_unresolved_complaints
equity_bank_db-# FROM BANK_EMPLOYEE e
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON e.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON e.employee_id = w.employee_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN l ON e.employee_id = l.employee_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT cc ON e.employee_id = cc.employee_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.employee_position, bb.branch_name
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT w.withdrawal_id) > 5 
equity_bank_db-#    AND COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) > 1000000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC;
 employee_id |  employee_name   | employee_position |  branch_name   | number_of_withdrawals_processed | total_withdrawn_amount | number_of_loans_processed | total_loan_amount | number_of_complaints_handled | number_of_unresolved_complaints

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 17: Display customers with total fixed deposit principal > 5,000,000
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS number_of_bank_accounts,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT bc.card_id) AS number_of_bank_cards,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT bf.beneficiary_id) AS number_of_beneficiaries,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT mb.mobile_banking_id) AS number_of_mobile_banking_registrations,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT fd.fixed_deposit_id) AS number_of_fixed_deposits,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(fd.principal_amount), 0) AS total_fixed_deposit_principal,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(ip.premium_amount), 0) AS total_insurance_premiums
equity_bank_db-# FROM CUSTOMER c
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON c.customer_id = ba.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_CARD bc ON ba.account_id = bc.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BENEFICIARY bf ON c.customer_id = bf.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN MOBILE_BANKING mb ON c.customer_id = mb.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN FIXED_DEPOSIT fd ON ba.account_id = fd.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN INSURANCE_POLICY ip ON c.customer_id = ip.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COALESCE(SUM(fd.principal_amount), 0) > 5000000
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY total_fixed_deposit_principal DESC;
 national_id |      customer_name      | number_of_bank_accounts | number_of_bank_cards | number_of_beneficiaries | number_of_mobile_banking_registrations | number_of_fixed_deposits | total_fixed_deposit_principal | total_loan_amount | total_repayment_amount | total_insurance_premiums

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 18: Display customers with more than one registered banking product
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS number_of_accounts,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT bc.card_id) AS number_of_cards,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT bf.beneficiary_id) AS number_of_beneficiaries,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT mb.mobile_banking_id) AS number_of_mobile_banking_registrations,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount
equity_bank_db-# FROM BANK_ACCOUNT ba
equity_bank_db-# RIGHT JOIN CUSTOMER c ON ba.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_CARD bc ON ba.account_id = bc.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BENEFICIARY bf ON c.customer_id = bf.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN MOBILE_BANKING mb ON c.customer_id = mb.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, at.account_type_name
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT bc.card_id) + 
equity_bank_db-#        COUNT(DISTINCT bf.beneficiary_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT mb.mobile_banking_id) > 1
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY number_of_accounts DESC;
 national_id |       customer_name       |    account_type_name     | number_of_accounts | number_of_cards | number_of_beneficiaries | number_of_mobile_banking_registrations | total_deposited_amount | total_withdrawn_amount | total_loan_amount | total_repayment_amount

equity_bank_db=# -- Query 19: Display customers with >2 repayments and outstanding balance
equity_bank_db=# SELECT 
equity_bank_db-#     c.national_id,
equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_name,
equity_bank_db-#     lt.loan_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     e.employee_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     l.loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(lr.repayment_id) AS number_of_repayments,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(cl.collateral_value), 0) AS total_collateral_value,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(ip.premium_amount), 0) AS total_insurance_premiums,
equity_bank_db-#     (l.loan_amount - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) AS outstanding_loan_balance
equity_bank_db-# FROM LOAN l
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN CUSTOMER c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN LOAN_TYPE lt ON l.loan_type_id = lt.loan_type_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_EMPLOYEE e ON l.employee_id = e.employee_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON e.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN GUARANTOR g ON l.loan_id = g.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN COLLATERAL cl ON l.loan_id = cl.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN INSURANCE_POLICY ip ON l.loan_id = ip.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, lt.loan_type_name, e.employee_name, 
equity_bank_db-#          bb.branch_name, l.loan_id, l.loan_amount
equity_bank_db-# HAVING COUNT(lr.repayment_id) > 2 
equity_bank_db-#    AND (l.loan_amount - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) > 0
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY outstanding_loan_balance DESC;
 national_id | customer_name | loan_type_name | employee_name | branch_name | loan_amount | number_of_repayments | total_repayment_amount | total_guaranteed_amount | total_collateral_value | total_insurance_premiums | outstanding_loan_balance 
-------------+---------------+----------------+---------------+-------------+-------------+----------------------+------------------------+-------------------------+------------------------+--------------------------+--------------------------
(0 rows)

equity_bank_db=# SELECT

equity_bank_db-#     c.customer_type,
equity_bank_db-#     at.account_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.branch_name,
equity_bank_db-#     bb.district_name,
equity_bank_db-#     e.employee_name,
equity_bank_db-#     cu.currency_name,
equity_bank_db-#     lt.loan_type_name,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS number_of_accounts,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT d.deposit_id) AS number_of_deposits,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(cl.collateral_value), 0) AS total_collateral_value,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT bc.card_id) AS number_of_cards,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT bf.beneficiary_id) AS number_of_beneficiaries,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT mb.mobile_banking_id) AS number_of_mobile_banking_registrations,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(fd.principal_amount), 0) AS total_fixed_deposit_principal,
equity_bank_db-#     COALESCE(SUM(ip.premium_amount), 0) AS total_insurance_premiums,
equity_bank_db-#     COUNT(DISTINCT cc.complaint_id) AS number_of_complaints,
equity_bank_db-#     bt.target_amount,
equity_bank_db-#     CASE 
equity_bank_db-#         WHEN bt.target_amount > 0 
equity_bank_db-#         THEN (COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) / bt.target_amount) * 100 
equity_bank_db-#         ELSE 0 
equity_bank_db-#     END AS branch_performance_percentage,
equity_bank_db-#     (COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) AS outstanding_loan_balance
equity_bank_db-# FROM CUSTOMER c
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON c.customer_id = ba.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON ba.branch_id = bb.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN BANK_EMPLOYEE e ON bb.branch_id = e.branch_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
equity_bank_db-# INNER JOIN CURRENCY cu ON d.currency_id = cu.currency_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_TYPE lt ON l.loan_type_id = lt.loan_type_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN GUARANTOR g ON l.loan_id = g.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN COLLATERAL cl ON l.loan_id = cl.loan_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BANK_CARD bc ON ba.account_id = bc.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BENEFICIARY bf ON c.customer_id = bf.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN MOBILE_BANKING mb ON c.customer_id = mb.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN FIXED_DEPOSIT fd ON ba.account_id = fd.account_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN INSURANCE_POLICY ip ON c.customer_id = ip.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
equity_bank_db-# LEFT JOIN BRANCH_TARGET bt ON bb.branch_id = bt.branch_id AND at.account_type_id = bt.account_type_id
equity_bank_db-# GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, at.account_type_name, 
equity_bank_db-#          bb.branch_name, bb.district_name, e.employee_name, cu.currency_name, 
equity_bank_db-#          lt.loan_type_name, bt.target_amount
equity_bank_db-# HAVING 
equity_bank_db-#     (COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) > 0
equity_bank_db-#     AND COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)
equity_bank_db-#     AND COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) > 0
equity_bank_db-#     AND (COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) > 0
equity_bank_db-# ORDER BY bb.district_name, bb.branch_name, c.customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) DESC;

    at.account_type_name,
    bb.branch_name,
    bb.district_name,
    e.employee_name,
    cu.currency_name,
    lt.loan_type_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ba.account_id) AS number_of_accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.deposit_id) AS number_of_deposits,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) AS total_deposited_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(w.withdrawal_amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) AS total_loan_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0) AS total_repayment_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(cl.collateral_value), 0) AS total_collateral_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bc.card_id) AS number_of_cards,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bf.beneficiary_id) AS number_of_beneficiaries,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mb.mobile_banking_id) AS number_of_mobile_banking_registrations,
    COALESCE(SUM(fd.principal_amount), 0) AS total_fixed_deposit_principal,
    COALESCE(SUM(ip.premium_amount), 0) AS total_insurance_premiums,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cc.complaint_id) AS number_of_complaints,
    bt.target_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN bt.target_amount > 0
        THEN (COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) / bt.target_amount) * 100
        ELSE 0
    END AS branch_performance_percentage,
    (COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) AS outstanding_loan_balance
FROM CUSTOMER c
INNER JOIN BANK_ACCOUNT ba ON c.customer_id = ba.customer_id
INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TYPE at ON ba.account_type_id = at.account_type_id
INNER JOIN BANK_BRANCH bb ON ba.branch_id = bb.branch_id
INNER JOIN BANK_EMPLOYEE e ON bb.branch_id = e.branch_id
INNER JOIN DEPOSIT d ON ba.account_id = d.account_id
INNER JOIN CURRENCY cu ON d.currency_id = cu.currency_id
LEFT JOIN WITHDRAWAL w ON ba.account_id = w.account_id
LEFT JOIN LOAN l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
LEFT JOIN LOAN_TYPE lt ON l.loan_type_id = lt.loan_type_id
LEFT JOIN LOAN_REPAYMENT lr ON l.loan_id = lr.loan_id
LEFT JOIN GUARANTOR g ON l.loan_id = g.loan_id
LEFT JOIN COLLATERAL cl ON l.loan_id = cl.loan_id
LEFT JOIN BANK_CARD bc ON ba.account_id = bc.account_id
LEFT JOIN BENEFICIARY bf ON c.customer_id = bf.customer_id
LEFT JOIN MOBILE_BANKING mb ON c.customer_id = mb.customer_id
LEFT JOIN FIXED_DEPOSIT fd ON ba.account_id = fd.account_id
LEFT JOIN INSURANCE_POLICY ip ON c.customer_id = ip.customer_id
LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
LEFT JOIN BRANCH_TARGET bt ON bb.branch_id = bt.branch_id AND at.account_type_id = bt.account_type_id
GROUP BY c.national_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, at.account_type_name,
         bb.branch_name, bb.district_name, e.employee_name, cu.currency_name,
         lt.loan_type_name, bt.target_amount
HAVING
    (COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) > 0
    AND COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)
    AND COALESCE(SUM(d.deposit_amount), 0) > 0
    AND (COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(lr.repayment_amount), 0)) > 0
ORDER BY bb.district_name, bb.branch_name, c.customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.loan_amount), 0) DESC;
 national_id |       customer_name       | customer_type |    account_type_name    |    branch_name     | district_name |       employee_name       |   currency_name    |    loan_type_name     | number_of_accounts | number_of_deposits | total_deposited_amount | total_withdrawn_amount | total_loan_amount | total_repayment_amount | total_guaranteed_amount | total_collateral_value | number_of_cards | number_of_beneficiaries | number_of_mobile_banking_registrations | total_fixed_deposit_principal | total_insurance_premiums | number_of_complaints | target_amount | branch_performance_percentage | outstanding_loan_balance
